source.sqlReaderQuery: DTP CIS (Diphtheria, Tetanus, Pertussis) SELECT DISTINCT 	M.SBSB_ID AS Member, 	'DTP' AS Service, 	C.dtmDOS AS Effdate, 	'MEDREC_' + P.PlanCode AS SrcFile FROM MedRecord.APP_MRec.CIS C INNER JOIN MedRecord.APP_MRec.vwDimMember M ON M.MemberID = C.MemberID INNER JOIN MedRecord.APP_MRec.DimPlan P ON P.PlanID = C.PlanID WHERE C.Pertussis = 1 OR C.Tetanus = 1 OR C.Diphtheria = 1 WHERE C.Diphtheria = 1  UNION MMR CIS (Measles, Mumps, Rubella) SELECT DISTINCT 	M.SBSB_ID AS Member, 	'MMR' AS Service, 	C.dtmDOS AS Effdate, 	'MEDREC_' + P.PlanCode AS SrcFile FROM MedRecord.APP_MRec.CIS C INNER JOIN MedRecord.APP_MRec.vwDimMember M ON M.MemberID = C.MemberID INNER JOIN MedRecord.APP_MRec.DimPlan P ON P.PlanID = C.PlanID WHERE C.Rubella = 1 	OR C.Mumps = 1 	OR C.Measles = 1  UNION IPV CIS (Polio) SELECT DISTINCT 	M.SBSB_ID AS Member, 	'IPV' AS Service, 	C.dtmDOS AS Effdate, 	'MEDREC_' + P.PlanCode AS SrcFile FROM MedRecord.APP_MRec.CIS C INNER JOIN MedRecord.APP_MRec.vwDimMember M ON M.MemberID = C.MemberID INNER JOIN MedRecord.APP_MRec.DimPlan P ON P.PlanID = C.PlanID WHERE C.Polio = 1 WHERE C.IPV = 1  UNION EXAM (HlthandDevHistory, PhysicalExam, and HlthEd//Anticipatory Guidance) SELECT DISTINCT 	M.SBSB_ID AS Member, 	'EXAM' AS Service, 	W.DOS AS Effdate, 	'MEDREC_' + P.PlanCode AS SrcFile FROM MedRecord.APP_MRec.WCV W INNER JOIN MedRecord.APP_MRec.vwDimMember M ON M.MemberID = W.MemberID INNER JOIN MedRecord.APP_MRec.DimPlan P ON P.PlanID = W.PlanID WHERE W.Hlth_Dev_His = 1 	OR W.PhysicalExam = 1 	OR W.HlthEd_A_G = 1  UNION VAR CIS (VZV) SELECT DISTINCT 	M.SBSB_ID AS Member, 	'VAR' AS Service, 	C.dtmDOS AS Effdate, 	'MEDREC_' + P.PlanCode AS SrcFile FROM MedRecord.APP_MRec.CIS C INNER JOIN MedRecord.APP_MRec.vwDimMember M ON M.MemberID = C.MemberID INNER JOIN MedRecord.APP_MRec.DimPlan P ON P.PlanID = C.PlanID WHERE C.VZV = 1  UNION LEAD SELECT DISTINCT 	M.SBSB_ID AS Member, 	'LEAD' AS Service, 	L.DOS AS Effdate, 	'MEDREC_' + P.PlanCode AS SrcFile FROM MedRecord.APP_MRec.Lead L INNER JOIN MedRecord.APP_MRec.vwDimMember M ON M.MemberID = L.MemberID INNER JOIN MedRecord.APP_MRec.DimPlan P ON P.PlanID = L.PlanID WHERE L.Lead = 1  UNION HEPB CIS SELECT DISTINCT 	M.SBSB_ID AS Member, 	'HEPB' AS Service, 	C.dtmDOS AS Effdate, 	'MEDREC_' + P.PlanCode AS SrcFile FROM MedRecord.APP_MRec.CIS C INNER JOIN MedRecord.APP_MRec.vwDimMember M ON M.MemberID = C.MemberID INNER JOIN MedRecord.APP_MRec.DimPlan P ON P.PlanID = C.PlanID WHERE C.HepB = 1  UNION HIB CIS SELECT DISTINCT 	M.SBSB_ID AS Member, 	'HIB' AS Service, 	C.dtmDOS AS Effdate, 	'MEDREC_' + P.PlanCode AS SrcFile FROM MedRecord.APP_MRec.CIS C INNER JOIN MedRecord.APP_MRec.vwDimMember M ON M.MemberID = C.MemberID INNER JOIN MedRecord.APP_MRec.DimPlan P ON P.PlanID = C.PlanID WHERE C.HiB = 1

INSERT INTO EPSDTMedRecordsStagingLog(MedRecordsStagingId, MessageId, LogDateTime, LogDesc)
SELECT 
	MRS.MedRecordsStagingId, 
	16, --16=invalid effective date
	GETDATE(), 
	'Member=' + ISNULL(Member,'') + ',Service=' + ISNULL(Service,'') + ',EffDateString=' + ISNULL(EffDateString,'') + ',SrcFile=' + ISNULL(SrcFile,'') + ',LeadResult=' + ISNULL(LeadResult,'')
FROM EPSDTMedRecordsStaging MRS
WHERE ISDATE(MRS.EffDateString) = 1

INSERT INTO EPSDTMedRecordsStagingLog(MedRecordsStagingId, MessageId, LogDateTime, LogDesc)
SELECT 
	MRS.MedRecordsStagingId, 
	8, --8=invalid date range (wont fit in smalldatetime)
	GETDATE(), 
	'Member=' + ISNULL(Member,'') + ',Service=' + ISNULL(Service,'') + ',EffDateString=' + ISNULL(EffDateString,'') + ',SrcFile=' + ISNULL(SrcFile,'') + ',LeadResult=' + ISNULL(LeadResult,'')
FROM EPSDTMedRecordsStaging MRS
WHERE ISDATE(MRS.EffDateString) = 1
	AND CONVERT(DATETIME, MRS.EffDateString) NOT BETWEEN '1900-01-01' AND '2079-06-06'

DECLARE @EnvironName VARCHAR(100)
DECLARE @Path VARCHAR(8000)

SET @EnvironName = (SELECT TOP 1 Value FROM EPSDTAppConfig WHERE ConfigKey = 'Environment')

SET @Path = 
	--rootfolder
	(SELECT TOP 1 Value FROM EPSDTAppConfig WHERE ConfigKey = 'RootPath' AND EnvironName LIKE '%' + @EnvironName + '%') +
	--folder/filename
	'SystemRefresh\WellServicesFromMedRecords\' +
	CONVERT(VARCHAR(4), YEAR(GETDATE())) + '\' +
	RIGHT('0' + CONVERT(VARCHAR(2), MONTH(GETDATE())), 2) + '\'

SELECT
	@Path,
	@Path + 'AGP_WellServicesFromMedRecords_Log.csv'

DECLARE @JobId INT

SET @JobId = (SELECT JobId FROM EPSDTJob WHERE JobCode = 'SystemRefresh')

EXEC spCreateAppLog @JobId, 'JobRun', 'MedRecords Staging to WellServices', 0, 0

EXEC spLoadWellServicesFromMedRecords
